description.value: Big Al's Bakery and Deli has been a beloved institution in Oliver, BC — Canada's wine capital — for over 40 years, turning out fresh-baked breads, donuts, cakes, and pies daily alongside a full deli counter stocked with premium meats and cheeses. The bistro-style restaurant serves breakfast and lunch, with specialty coffees from local Okanagan roasters and hot lunch options like brisket grilled cheese and poutine. It's an ideal stop for touring cyclists to grab a hot meal, stock up on picnic provisions, or pick up locally produced milk and yogurt.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is a real, active bakery and deli at 6030 Main St, Oliver BC, serving the community for over 40 years. No website content mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific infrastructure, so those remain null.
